name: @innis/nostr-nip29
description: Pure domain helpers for NIP-29 relay-based groups: parse kind 39000 group-metadata events into Group value objects, build kind 9 group chat messages, and copy a group's `h` tag onto outgoing events. No I/O — querying and rendering live in the consumer.

tasks.coverage: rm -rf cov_profile && deno test -A --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile --lcov --output=cov_profile/lcov.info && deno coverage cov_profile && deno run --allow-read jsr:@innis/coding-standards@^0.1.0/check-coverage
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task coverage && deno task exports-tested && deno task docs
